g.text: One Ephemeral, One Durable -- Same Shape, Different Guarantees
Both are indexed on geohash, but only one of them needs to survive a restart
no disk write on the hot path
Both tables key off the same geohash concept -- a query fans out to both and merges by distance, but they scale independently.
dynamic_locations optimizes purely for write throughput and staleness-tolerance; static_pois optimizes for durability and read-through caching.
